title: Card front
brief: The front of a payment card: chip with etched lines, contactless arcs, a spaced number in mono type, holder and expiry, plus a Copy number button underneath.

inspiration.note: Took the chip with etched lines and the contactless arcs placed at the top corners; the generic mark, palette and copy button are ours, no real brand logos.
Took the idea of a quiet secondary button with a darker hover and an offset focus ring.
